001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.scopedkeyvalues.provider;
002
003import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogConfig;
004import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEventFactory;
005import io.jstach.rainbowgum.scopedkeyvalues.ScopedKeyValues;
006import io.jstach.rainbowgum.slf4j.RainbowGumSLF4JServiceProvider;
007import io.jstach.rainbowgum.spi.RainbowGumServiceProvider;
008import io.jstach.svc.ServiceProvider;
009
010/**
011 * Registers {@link ScopedKeyValuesLogEventFactory} in {@link LogConfig#serviceRegistry()}
012 * under {@code RainbowGumSLF4JServiceProvider#SCOPED_KEY_VALUES_SERVICE_NAME} - the one
013 * thing this module needs to do for {@code rainbowgum-slf4j} to start merging
014 * {@link ScopedKeyValues} into every event it builds, underneath MDC. Simply having this
015 * module on the classpath is enough - no configuration, no properties.
016 */
017@ServiceProvider(RainbowGumServiceProvider.class)
018public final class ScopedKeyValuesConfigurator implements RainbowGumServiceProvider.Configurator {
019
020        /**
021         * For service loader.
022         */
023        public ScopedKeyValuesConfigurator() {
024        }
025
026        @Override
027        public boolean configure(@SuppressWarnings("exports") LogConfig config, @SuppressWarnings("exports") Pass pass) {
028                config.serviceRegistry()
029                        .put(LogEventFactory.class, RainbowGumSLF4JServiceProvider.SCOPED_KEY_VALUES_SERVICE_NAME,
030                                        ScopedKeyValuesLogEventFactory.INSTANCE);
031                return true;
032        }
033
034}
